name: Toucannon
normal: black body, orange/red/yellow banded beak, white chest, blue feet
shiny: beak turns magenta-pink and violet-blue, darker than normal; body, chest and feet unchanged
desc: beak bands shift: red stays red, orange to magenta, yellow-orange to violet, yellow to blue
source: pokemondb.net/sprites/toucannon HOME normal vs shiny (128px, pixel-aligned)
note: Measured both sprites. Normal beak hue 34(L.57,C.18)->4; 43(L.72)->321 magenta; 76-88(L.82-.87)->278-288 violet at L~.47; 104(L.89)->263 blue at L.54. Blue feet (hue 228) and all greys unchanged. Earlier draft (orange->azure) was wrong. Re-checked: simulating these rules on the normal sprite cuts mean OKLab error vs the shiny sprite from 0.122 to 0.049 with zero leak onto unchanged pixels (dark body is rendered slightly lighter in the shiny sprite, not expressible as a rule).

name: Quagsire
normal: light blue body, cream belly, black spots, red-orange cheek gills
shiny: body turns pink-magenta (hue ~325), belly cream; cheeks a duller red
note: Measured both. Body hue 197-246 (L.73-.94, C~.08) -> 322-326 (C~.09-.10, L about equal). Gill/cheek red 23 (C.12) -> 9 (C.077, L up). Earlier draft target 45 (orange) was wrong; it is pink-magenta, not salmon. Re-checked: rule simulation cuts mean OKLab error 0.139 -> 0.014.

name: Aerodactyl
normal: grey-purple body and wings, lighter cream belly, white teeth
shiny: green body and wings, lighter belly

name: Flygon
normal: dark green and light green body, red eyes and wing outlines
shiny: dark green parts become sky blue, red becomes orange
desc: green turns sky blue, red turns orange
source: https://www.fandomspot.com/shiny-dragon-type-pokemon/ and primagames shiny dragon list (via search snippets)
note: Draft said blue-teal with red staying; sources say red becomes orange, so a red rule was added and green target moved to sky blue.

name: Wailord
source: search result listing Wailmer/Wailord among Hoenn water types that turn purple when shiny
note: Purple confirmed by one article; pink tint from memory.

name: Wailmer
source: search result listing Wailmer/Wailord among Hoenn water types that turn purple when shiny

name: Slugma
shiny: grey body (near colorless), underside not confirmed
source: https://bogleech.com/pokemon/shiny.html (search snippet: shiny Slugma switched to pure grey)
note: Draft had purple-blue; a source says pure grey, so chroma is cut to 0.15 with a faint violet hue.

name: Alomomola
normal: pink body, blue eyes and fin markings
desc: pink body turns purple-magenta, blue eyes turn green
note: Measured both. Body hue 5 (L.80,C.076) -> 321 (L.76,C.089), 3625 px. Small dark-blue eye px hue 252 (L.37,C.09) -> 150 green (L.71,C.19). Earlier draft (teal) was wrong. Rule windows wrap across 0 deg: make_shiny_pack.parse_rules/recolor handle wrap ((s-w)%360 .. (s+w)%360), verified by simulation: mean OKLab error 0.079 -> 0.040.

name: Mantine
normal: dark blue-grey top, pale lavender wing tips and belly, pink-white accents
shiny: same dark blue top but more saturated and lighter; wing tips and belly become light blue
desc: top turns bright blue, lavender areas turn light blue
note: Measured both. Top hue 254 (L.35,C.084) -> 264 (L.52,C.195): hue nearly unchanged, much more chroma and lightness. Lavender 291-310 (L.70-.84,C.05) -> 263-266 (C.06-.10, L.77). Pale greys gain a blue-lavender tint. Earlier draft (pink-purple) was wrong. Re-checked: rule simulation cuts mean OKLab error 0.108 -> 0.030.

name: Mamoswine
normal: brown-olive fur, cream tusks, pale grey underfur, blue-tinted ice patches
shiny: golden olive-yellow fur, tusks stay cream, ice patches turn teal-green
desc: brown fur turns golden yellow, blue ice turns teal
note: Measured both. Fur hue 64 (L.52,C.087, 3769 px) -> 114 (C.10,L.57). Light fur 81 -> 108. Blue ice/accents 215-226 (C.12) -> 164-180 (C.07). Greys unchanged (hue ~77). Earlier draft (purple) was wrong. Re-checked: rule simulation cuts mean OKLab error 0.069 -> 0.020, no leak onto unchanged pixels.

name: Carbink
normal: pale violet-grey rock body, blue and cyan-white crystals
shiny: body turns neutral grey, crystals turn deeper saturated blue, frosting turns light blue
desc: purple-grey body goes neutral grey, crystals turn deeper blue
note: Measured both. Body hue 289 (L.70,C.05, 2926 px) -> C.003 (L.59): desaturated grey. Crystals 214-251 (L.80-.94) -> 255-263 (C~.09-.10, L.63-.75). Near-white areas (L>.85, C~0) -> hue 217 C.087. Earlier draft (red-orange gems) was wrong; no red seen. Pink gems were too low-chroma to measure; left alone. Re-checked: rule simulation cuts mean OKLab error 0.132 -> 0.048; residual is the frosting getting darker (L -0.09), which grey tint rules cannot express.

name: Sableye
normal: vivid purple body, pale blue-white gem eyes, red chest gem
shiny: gold/yellow body (hue ~94), pale gem facets turn pale yellow-white, red chest gem turns green
desc: purple body turns gold, red chest gem turns green
note: Measured both. Body hue 299 (L.51,C.20, 2508 px) -> 94-95 (L.73,C.10). Pale blue gem facets (hue 212-245, L.83-.94) -> ~108 pale yellow. Re-check found the red chest gem is measurable after all: 22 px at hue 20-24 (L.64,C.195) -> hue 145 green (C.17, L.76); added rule 21>145:10:0.9:1.1 (body is at 299, no overlap). Earlier draft (body stays purple, gems red) was wrong. Rule simulation cuts mean OKLab error 0.334 -> 0.018.

name: Luvdisc
normal: pink heart body, white-pink face and belly
shiny: golden yellow-orange body (hue ~90), pale belly unchanged
note: Measured both. Body hue 6 (L.71,C.159, 4345 px) -> 90 (L.82,C.136); pale pink 356 (C.06) -> 34 pale. Whites and greys unchanged (hue ~328). Earlier draft (blue-teal) was wrong. Re-check: the previous window 6>90:24 reached hue 342-30 and tinted the pale pink/white belly yellow (leak 0.079 on 530 unchanged px, hue 340-360, C~.033); narrowed to 8>90:16 (leak 0.007, mean error 0.197 -> 0.016).

name: Pidgeot
normal: brown body, cream chest and face, red outer and yellow center crest
shiny: crest and tail red turn yellow-gold, body brown becomes warmer golden-brown, cream becomes richer yellow
desc: red crest turns yellow, plumage goes golden
note: Measured both. Red 17-30 (L.57-.65,C.19) -> 81-90 (L.75-.77,C.13). Brown 56 (C.08) -> 77 (C.11); 69 -> 87. Cream 97-102 (L.86-.93) -> 102-105 with chroma x1.7. Pale pinkish 335-345 (C.05) -> 84-90 (C.12). Hue shifts of body are modest, mostly chroma; earlier draft (darken) was wrong. Re-checked: rule simulation cuts mean OKLab error 0.088 -> 0.024.

name: Exeggutor
normal: green leaf fronds, tan-brown trunk, yellow-cream heads
shiny: fronds turn tan-golden brown (hue ~51, low chroma), trunk turns golden yellow, heads unchanged
desc: green leaves turn tan-gold, brown trunk turns yellow
note: Measured both. Leaves hue 120-140 (L.61,C.164, 2139 px) -> 51 (L.68,C.084). Trunk 59-64 (L.64,C.07) -> 100-101 (L.76,C.11). Heads (hue 95-104) unchanged. Sportskeeda's red leaves is not supported; leaves are tan, not red. Re-checked: rule simulation cuts mean OKLab error 0.140 -> 0.019.

name: Feraligatr
normal: blue body, red jagged back spikes and jaw markings, cream belly
shiny: teal body, spikes turn blue, cream turns slightly yellow
desc: blue body turns teal, red spikes turn blue
source: https://www.sportskeeda.com/pokemon/feraligatr (snippet); gameslearningsociety also says cyan body with indigo spikes
note: Draft said red body, which is wrong: shiny Totodile line is teal/green with blue spikes.

name: Bellossom
normal: dark green leaf skirt with yellow-green edges, red petals, light green face and arms
shiny: petals turn pink, face and arms turn pink-lavender (hue ~312), dark green leaves turn teal-green (hue ~152), yellow-green skirt edges stay pale yellow-green
desc: red petals turn pink, light green skin turns pink-lavender, dark green leaves turn teal
note: Measured both. Petals 30 (L.63,C.21, 1077 px) -> 346 (L.76,C.14), 49 -> 3. Dark green leaves 135-150 (L.62,C.167, 1834 px) -> 152 (L.73,C.134); the earlier 134>164 overshot (measured 152). Light green face/arms 122-130 (L.84,C.11, ~860 px) -> 312 pink-lavender (C.085, L.80): the earlier pass missed this and its 134>164:14 window (120-148) would have turned the skin teal. Windows split at ~131. Yellow-green 85-110 -> 114 slight. Earlier draft (blue body, petals unchanged) was wrong. Rule simulation cuts mean OKLab error 0.135 -> 0.024 (the earlier rule set made it worse, 0.170).

name: Slaking
normal: brown fur, cream face and belly, pink cheeks/nose
shiny: paler greyer tan-brown fur, less saturated cream, orange-tinted nose/cheeks
desc: brown fur goes paler and greyer
note: Measured both. Fur hue 66 (L.53,C.066, 2404 px) -> 43 (L.60,C.037): lighter, less chroma, slightly redder. Cream 86-104 (C.06) -> ~59 (C.026). Pink 353 (C.07) -> 53 (C.13). Greys gain slight warm tint (C~.045). Subtle change as expected. Re-checked: rule simulation cuts mean OKLab error 0.060 -> 0.015.

name: Sharpedo
normal: blue upper body, white belly, red-orange eye and fin markings
shiny: magenta-purple upper body (hue ~325), red markings a duller red, belly slightly lavender-tinted
note: Measured both. Body hue 247 (L.45,C.10, 1761 px) -> 325 (L.51,C.17). Red 17-23 (C.10-.12) -> 4-8 (C.07-.08, lighter). Pale greys gain a faint purple tint (hue 310-317). Earlier draft target 292 (violet) was too blue; measured is nearer magenta. Re-checked: rule simulation cuts mean OKLab error 0.131 -> 0.030.
